units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王认真地求婚了：

en.t: Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, made a serious proposal of marriage:

units.source_text: “着裳仪式现已完成，更有何辞可以推托？……”

en.t: “Her coming-of-age ceremony has now been completed; what excuse could there still be to put it off? ...”

units.source_text: “皇上前曾示意，要她入宫任尚侍之职，现正奏请免征。

en.t: “His Majesty previously indicated that she should enter court service as Naishi no Kami, and I am now petitioning to have her excused from the summons.

units.source_text: 须待复旨到后，再行决定其他事宜。”

en.t: We must wait until the imperial reply arrives before deciding the other matters.”

units.source_text: 内大臣在灯光之下约略见过玉鬘一面，

en.t: The Inner Minister had once caught a brief glimpse of Tamakazura by lamplight,
and he kept thinking that he wished he could see her once more.

units.source_text: 他想：“此女倘有缺陷，太政大臣不会如此重视。”

en.t: He thought, “If this young woman had any flaw, the Chancellor would not value her so highly.”
Because of this, he became all the more unable to give up his longing for her.

units.source_text: 现在他回想起从前做的那个梦，

en.t: Now he recalled the dream he had once had,
and only then realized that it had truly been an omen.

units.source_text: 他只对弘徽殿女御说出实情。

en.t: He revealed the truth only to the Kokiden Consort.
